SELECT d.purchase_request_detail_id AS purchaseRequestDetailId, h.request_no AS requestNo, pc.confirm_no AS confirmNo, pc.confirm_dt AS confirmDt, d.supplier_id AS supplierId, c.customer_code AS supplierCode, c.customer_name AS supplierName, d.material_id AS materialId, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.unit AS unit, m.material_type_code AS materialTypeCode, CASE WHEN m.inspect_type = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS inspectAt, d.confirm_qty AS confirmQty, COALESCE(o.ordered_qty, 0) AS orderedQty, d.confirm_qty - COALESCE(o.ordered_qty, 0) AS remainQty, d.request_delivery_dt AS requestDeliveryDt, d.confirm_delivery_dt AS confirmDeliveryDt, d.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, d.unit_price AS unitPrice, d.currency_code AS currencyCode, COALESCE(d.tax_type, 'TAXABLE') AS taxType, COALESCE(d.vat_included_at, 'N') AS vatIncludedAt, d.order_type AS orderType, oci.item_nm AS orderTypeName, d.use_type AS useType, uci.item_nm AS useTypeName, d.confirm_remark AS remark, CAST(NULL AS numeric) AS stockQty FROM tb_purchase_request_dt d JOIN tb_purchase_request_hd h ON h.purchase_request_id = d.purchase_request_id AND h.tenant_id = d.tenant_id JOIN tb_purchase_confirm_hd pc ON pc.purchase_confirm_id = d.purchase_confirm_id AND pc.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN o ON o.purchase_request_detail_id = d.purchase_request_detail_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = d.material_id AND m.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = d.supplier_id AND c.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = d.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group ocg ON ocg.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND ocg.group_code = 'PURCHASE_ORDER_TYPE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item oci ON oci.group_id = ocg.common_code_group_id AND oci.item_code = d.order_type LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group ucg ON ucg.tenant_id = d.tenant_id AND ucg.group_code = 'PURCHASE_USE_TYPE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item uci ON uci.group_id = ucg.common_code_group_id AND uci.item_code = d.use_type WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.use_at = 'Y' AND pc.use_at = 'Y' AND d.order_close_at = 'N' AND d.confirm_qty - COALESCE(o.ordered_qty, 0) > 0
AND pc.confirm_dt >= CAST(#{fromDt} AS date)
AND pc.confirm_dt <= CAST(#{toDt} AS date)
AND (pc.confirm_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR h.request_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR c.customer_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR m.material_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY c.customer_name, pc.confirm_dt DESC, pc.confirm_no, d.line_no LIMIT 500

SELECT d.purchase_request_detail_id AS purchaseRequestDetailId, d.purchase_confirm_id AS purchaseConfirmId, pc.use_at AS confirmUseAt, d.material_id AS materialId, m.material_type_code AS materialTypeCode, CASE WHEN m.inspect_type = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS inspectAt, d.confirm_qty AS confirmQty, COALESCE((SELECT sum(od.order_qty) FROM tb_purchase_order_dt od JOIN tb_purchase_order_hd oh ON oh.purchase_order_id = od.purchase_order_id AND oh.tenant_id = od.tenant_id WHERE od.purchase_request_detail_id = d.purchase_request_detail_id AND oh.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND oh.use_at = 'Y'), 0) AS orderedQty, d.order_close_at AS orderCloseAt, d.supplier_id AS supplierId, d.currency_code AS currencyCode, d.order_type AS orderType, d.use_type AS useType, d.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, d.confirm_delivery_dt AS confirmDeliveryDt FROM tb_purchase_request_dt d JOIN tb_purchase_request_hd h ON h.purchase_request_id = d.purchase_request_id AND h.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_purchase_confirm_hd pc ON pc.purchase_confirm_id = d.purchase_confirm_id AND pc.tenant_id = d.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = d.material_id AND m.tenant_id = d.tenant_id WHERE d.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h.use_at = 'Y' AND d.purchase_request_detail_id IN #{id, jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY d.purchase_request_detail_id
FOR UPDATE OF d

SELECT m.material_id AS materialId, m.material_type_code AS materialTypeCode, CASE WHEN m.inspect_type = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS inspectAt FROM tb_material_info m WHERE m.material_id = #{materialId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND m.delete_status = 'N' AND m.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_common_code_item i JOIN tb_common_code_group g ON g.common_code_group_id = i.group_id WHERE g.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND g.group_code = 'PURCHASE_TAX_TYPE' AND g.use_at = 'Y' AND i.item_code = #{code} AND i.use_at = 'Y' )

INSERT INTO tb_purchase_order_hd ( tenant_id, order_no, order_dt, supplier_id, orderer_id, order_dept_id, currency_code, source_type, tax_type, vat_included_at, supply_amt, vat_amt, total_amt, remark, created_by, company_name, company_business_no, company_president_name, company_post_code, company_address, company_telephone_no, company_facsimile_no, company_stamp_image, company_logo_image, vendor_name, vendor_business_no, vendor_president_name, vendor_post_code, vendor_address, vendor_telephone_no, vendor_facsimile_no, vendor_charge, orderer_name, orderer_mobile_no ) SELECT t.tenant_id, #{orderNo}, CAST(#{orderDt} AS date), #{supplierId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{ordererId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{orderDeptId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{currencyCode}, #{sourceType}, #{taxType}, #{vatIncludedAt}, #{supplyAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{vatAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{totalAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{remark}, #{createdBy}, t.tenant_nm, t.business_registration_number, t.president_name, t.post_code, t.address, t.telephone_no, t.facsimile_no, t.stamp_image, t.logo_image, c.customer_name, c.business_no, c.president_name, c.post_code, c.address, c.telephone_no, c.facsimile_no, c.customer_charge, u.user_nm, u.mobile_no FROM tb_tenant t LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = #{supplierId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND c.tenant_id = t.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = #{ordererId, jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} RETURNING purchase_order_id

INSERT INTO tb_purchase_order_dt ( purchase_order_id, tenant_id, line_no, purchase_request_detail_id, material_id, order_qty, unit_price, delivery_dt, warehouse_id, order_type, use_type, inspect_at, supply_amt, vat_amt, total_amt, remark, created_by ) VALUES ( #{purchaseOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{lineNo}, #{purchaseRequestDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{materialId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{orderQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{unitPrice, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, CAST(#{deliveryDt} AS date), #{warehouseId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{orderType}, #{useType}, #{inspectAt}, #{supplyAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{vatAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{totalAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{remark}, #{createdBy} ) RETURNING purchase_order_detail_id

SELECT oh.purchase_order_id AS purchaseOrderId, oh.order_no AS orderNo, oh.order_dt AS orderDt, oh.supplier_id AS supplierId, oh.currency_code AS currencyCode, oh.source_type AS sourceType, oh.tax_type AS taxType, oh.vat_included_at AS vatIncludedAt, oh.use_at AS useAt FROM tb_purchase_order_hd oh WHERE oh.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND oh.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} FOR UPDATE OF oh
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_purchase_order_hd SET order_dt = CAST(#{orderDt} AS date), tax_type = #{taxType}, vat_included_at = #{vatIncludedAt}, supply_amt = #{supplyAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, vat_amt = #{vatAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, total_amt = #{totalAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND use_at = 'Y'

UPDATE tb_purchase_order_dt SET line_no = #{lineNo}, order_qty = #{orderQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, unit_price = #{unitPrice, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, delivery_dt = CAST(#{deliveryDt} AS date), warehouse_id = #{warehouseId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, inspect_at = #{inspectAt}, supply_amt = #{supplyAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, vat_amt = #{vatAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, total_amt = #{totalAmt, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE purchase_order_detail_id = #{purchaseOrderDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

UPDATE tb_purchase_order_hd SET use_at = 'N', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND use_at = 'Y'

UPDATE tb_purchase_request_dt SET request_qty = #{orderQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, request_delivery_dt = CAST(#{deliveryDt} AS date), confirm_qty = #{orderQty, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, confirm_delivery_dt = CAST(#{deliveryDt} AS date), warehouse_id = #{warehouseId, jdbcType=BIGINT}, unit_price = #{unitPrice, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, amount = #{amount, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE purchase_request_detail_id = #{purchaseRequestDetailId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

UPDATE tb_purchase_confirm_hd pc SET total_amt = COALESCE((SELECT sum(d.amount) FROM tb_purchase_request_dt d WHERE d.purchase_confirm_id = pc.purchase_confirm_id AND d.tenant_id = pc.tenant_id), 0), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE pc.purchase_confirm_id = #{purchaseConfirmId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND pc.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.select: SELECT oh.purchase_order_id AS purchaseOrderId, oh.order_no AS orderNo, oh.order_dt AS orderDt, oh.currency_code AS currencyCode, oh.tax_type AS taxType, oh.vat_included_at AS vatIncludedAt, oh.supply_amt AS supplyAmt, oh.vat_amt AS vatAmt, oh.total_amt AS totalAmt, oh.remark AS remark, oh.print_at AS printAt, oh.use_at AS useAt, COALESCE(oh.company_name, t.tenant_nm) AS companyName, COALESCE(oh.company_business_no, t.business_registration_number) AS companyBusinessNo, COALESCE(oh.company_president_name, t.president_name) AS companyPresidentName, COALESCE(oh.company_post_code, t.post_code) AS companyPostCode, COALESCE(oh.company_address, t.address) AS companyAddress, COALESCE(oh.company_telephone_no, t.telephone_no) AS companyTelephoneNo, COALESCE(oh.company_facsimile_no, t.facsimile_no) AS companyFacsimileNo, COALESCE(oh.company_stamp_image, t.stamp_image) AS companyStampImage, COALESCE(oh.company_logo_image, t.logo_image) AS companyLogoImage, COALESCE(oh.vendor_name, c.customer_name) AS vendorName, COALESCE(oh.vendor_business_no, c.business_no) AS vendorBusinessNo, COALESCE(oh.vendor_president_name, c.president_name) AS vendorPresidentName, COALESCE(oh.vendor_post_code, c.post_code) AS vendorPostCode, COALESCE(oh.vendor_address, c.address) AS vendorAddress, COALESCE(oh.vendor_telephone_no, c.telephone_no) AS vendorTelephoneNo, COALESCE(oh.vendor_facsimile_no, c.facsimile_no) AS vendorFacsimileNo, COALESCE(oh.vendor_charge, c.customer_charge) AS vendorCharge, COALESCE(oh.orderer_name, u.user_nm) AS ordererName, COALESCE(oh.orderer_mobile_no, u.mobile_no) AS ordererMobileNo FROM tb_purchase_order_hd oh LEFT JOIN tb_tenant t ON t.tenant_id = oh.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = oh.supplier_id AND c.tenant_id = oh.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = oh.orderer_id WHERE oh.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND oh.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT od.line_no AS lineNo, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.unit AS unit, od.order_qty AS orderQty, od.unit_price AS unitPrice, od.delivery_dt AS deliveryDt, od.supply_amt AS supplyAmt, od.vat_amt AS vatAmt, od.total_amt AS totalAmt, od.remark AS remark FROM tb_purchase_order_dt od LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = od.material_id AND m.tenant_id = od.tenant_id WHERE od.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND od.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY od.line_no
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_purchase_order_hd SET print_at = 'Y', printed_at = now(), printed_by = #{printedBy}, updated_by = #{printedBy}, updated_at = now() WHERE purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND use_at = 'Y'
mapper.select: SELECT oh.purchase_order_id AS purchaseOrderId, oh.order_no AS orderNo, oh.order_dt AS orderDt, oh.supplier_id AS supplierId, c.customer_code AS supplierCode, c.customer_name AS supplierName, u.user_nm AS ordererName, oh.currency_code AS currencyCode, oh.source_type AS sourceType, oh.tax_type AS taxType, oh.vat_included_at AS vatIncludedAt, oh.supply_amt AS supplyAmt, oh.vat_amt AS vatAmt, oh.total_amt AS totalAmt, oh.print_at AS printAt, oh.remark AS remark, oh.use_at AS useAt FROM tb_purchase_order_hd oh LEFT JOIN tb_customer_info c ON c.customer_id = oh.supplier_id AND c.tenant_id = oh.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON u.user_id = oh.orderer_id WHERE oh.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND oh.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT od.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, od.line_no AS lineNo, od.purchase_request_detail_id AS purchaseRequestDetailId, h.request_no AS requestNo, pc.confirm_no AS confirmNo, od.material_id AS materialId, m.material_code AS materialCode, m.material_name AS materialName, m.material_spec AS materialSpec, m.unit AS unit, od.order_qty AS orderQty, od.unit_price AS unitPrice, od.delivery_dt AS deliveryDt, od.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, od.order_type AS orderType, oci.item_nm AS orderTypeName, od.use_type AS useType, uci.item_nm AS useTypeName, od.inspect_at AS inspectAt, od.supply_amt AS supplyAmt, od.vat_amt AS vatAmt, od.total_amt AS totalAmt, od.receipt_close_at AS receiptCloseAt, od.remark AS remark, rd.confirm_qty AS confirmQty, rd.confirm_qty - COALESCE((SELECT sum(o2.order_qty) FROM tb_purchase_order_dt o2 JOIN tb_purchase_order_hd h2 ON h2.purchase_order_id = o2.purchase_order_id AND h2.tenant_id = o2.tenant_id WHERE o2.purchase_request_detail_id = od.purchase_request_detail_id AND h2.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND h2.use_at = 'Y' AND o2.purchase_order_detail_id <> od.purchase_order_detail_id), 0) AS remainQty, rd.supplier_id AS confirmSupplierId, rd.unit_price AS confirmUnitPrice, rd.confirm_delivery_dt AS confirmDeliveryDt, rd.warehouse_id AS confirmWarehouseId FROM tb_purchase_order_dt od JOIN tb_purchase_request_dt rd ON rd.purchase_request_detail_id = od.purchase_request_detail_id JOIN tb_purchase_request_hd h ON h.purchase_request_id = rd.purchase_request_id AND h.tenant_id = rd.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_purchase_confirm_hd pc ON pc.purchase_confirm_id = rd.purchase_confirm_id AND pc.tenant_id = rd.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_material_info m ON m.material_id = od.material_id AND m.tenant_id = od.tenant_id LEFT JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_id = od.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group ocg ON ocg.tenant_id = od.tenant_id AND ocg.group_code = 'PURCHASE_ORDER_TYPE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item oci ON oci.group_id = ocg.common_code_group_id AND oci.item_code = od.order_type LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_group ucg ON ucg.tenant_id = od.tenant_id AND ucg.group_code = 'PURCHASE_USE_TYPE' LEFT JOIN tb_common_code_item uci ON uci.group_id = ucg.common_code_group_id AND uci.item_code = od.use_type WHERE od.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND od.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} ORDER BY od.line_no

SELECT ad.purchase_order_detail_id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, sum(ad.arrival_qty) AS arrivedQty FROM tb_purchase_arrival_dt ad JOIN tb_purchase_arrival_hd ah ON ah.purchase_arrival_id = ad.purchase_arrival_id AND ah.tenant_id = ad.tenant_id WHERE ah.tenant_id = #{tenantId, jdbcType=BIGINT} AND ah.use_at = 'Y' AND ad.purchase_order_detail_id IN #{id, jdbcType=BIGINT} GROUP BY ad.purchase_order_detail_id
